text:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — planning a 2-day global "Migrate-to-Redwood" enablement sprint for 3/4 next month. Goal: onboarding + 1:1 migration triage for accounts flagged on renewal_watchlist. Need facilitators, lab leads, and a backup for recordings.
Tom (Enablement): I can own Day 1 intro + lab flow. Prefer morning PST slot. Can run breakout rotation 1.
Omar (Solutions): I can do Day 2 deep-dive (model pinning, routing policies). Will need 40m and 2 lab helpers.
Emilie (Customer): A bunch of our team are APAC-based. Can we run one session late AEST or split a cohort?
Priya (CS): Good call. Proposed windows: Day 1 -> 08:30 PDT / 17:30 CEST / 01:30 AEST (next day) for core intro + mixed timezone breakouts. Day 2 -> 09:00 PDT / 18:00 CEST for hands-on migration clinics. Thoughts?
Nina (CS Manager): We should cap hands-on labs to 20 seats per instance. If >20, spin second lab (Tom + Omar to coordinate).
Tom (Enablement): I'll make a signup + timezone matrix. Draft sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Migr8SignupExample
Tom (Enablement): Also creating a Miro board for lab tasks: https://miro.com/app/board/uX_example
Omar (Solutions): For labs we need ephemeral dedicated instances per customer or shared hosted sandbox? Shared sandboxes are quicker but customers on Private may need a different path. Suggest: hosted sandboxes for workshop + optional private concierge slots.
Priya (CS): Let's offer both. Add a private concierge checkbox on intake form. Intake form: https://forms.gle/migrate-intake-example (fields: company, timezone, primary blocker, private_concierge:true/false, renewal_window).
Emilie (Customer): Please add a short 'compliance concerns' checkbox — will help us route to security SME if flagged.
Tom (Enablement): Will add compliance question and a consent checkbox for recording.
calendar-bot: Reminder: "Migrate sprint facilitator check" scheduled 72h before Day 1.
Nina (CS Manager): We should tag high-risk renewals and request an executive sponsor invite 1:1 slot (15m) during Day 2. Who owns outreach?
Priya (CS): I'll own outreach for the renewal_watchlist accounts. Tom — can you reserve three 1:1 slots for exec check-ins?
Tom (Enablement): Yep, reserving three 15m executive slots on Day 2.
Omar (Solutions): Lab artifact note: I'll upload a sanitized sample dataset + prompt set to the repo. Link: https://github.com/redwood-internal/migrate-sprint-samples
Priya (CS): Action list: 1) Tom -> publish signup sheet + Miro by EOD Fri 2) Omar -> upload lab artifacts + confirm helpers by Tue 3/1 3) Nina -> confirm backup facilitator for recordings 4) Priya -> outreach to renewal_watchlist by next Wed.
Emilie (Customer): One more ask — can we have a 30m optional post-workshop office hours the following Wed for follow-ups? Our ops team prefers mid-week.
Tom (Enablement): Adding optional OH Wed 30min. I'll mark it in calendar as optional RSVP.
Priya (CS): Perfect. We'll include a short 5-question pulse at close (NPS + 4 checkboxes). Tom can share the poll link live.
calendar-bot: Event invites created for Day 1 and Day 2. Recordings enabled pending consent.
Nina (CS Manager): If any at-risk account shows low engagement in intake, flag immediately and we'll escalate to a success review.
Omar (Solutions): Final tech ask — ensure quotas for ephemeral sandboxes are provisioned (20 sandboxes x 2 instances). I'll ping infra.
Priya (CS): Thanks all. I'll post final schedule and invite owners here when calendar invites are confirmed. :thumbsup:
Emilie (Customer): Thanks team — excited.
